# Card2Leads

> Card2Leads is a business card scanner (visiting card scanner) and lead
> management application from BrillBrains Consultants Pvt. Ltd. It converts
> photographed or uploaded business cards into structured contact records that
> can be reviewed, classified, assigned to a team member, exported as Excel, CSV
> or VCF, and optionally synced to Google Contacts and Google Sheets. It is built
> for exhibitions and trade shows, where hundreds of cards are collected in a few
> days. It runs as a web app and as an Android app on Google Play.

## What it does

- Scans a business card with the phone camera, or accepts single and bulk image uploads of up to 200 cards at a time.
- Reads the front and the back of the same card as one contact.
- Extracts name, company, designation, mobile number, email address, address, city, state, pincode and country.
- Shows every extracted field for human review and correction before the record is saved.
- Tags each contact with the event or exhibition it was collected at, and the event date.
- Classifies contacts by salutation, industry, business type, business specialisation, customer status, customer rating and lead source, using dropdown lists each workspace can edit.
- Assigns a contact to a team member, so a shared stand's leads can be split by owner.
- Records a voice note against a contact and keeps the transcript with the record.
- Opens a pre-written WhatsApp message to a contact, using workspace templates and a catalogue link. Messages are never sent automatically.
- Adds a contact by hand when there is no card to scan.
- Exports approved contacts as Excel, CSV or VCF files, with the same columns in every format.
- Optionally writes selected contacts to Google Contacts, or creates and updates rows in Google Sheets.
- Round-trips a spreadsheet: download contacts as Excel with dropdown lists in the classification columns, edit them in Excel, upload the file back, and only the rows that changed are updated.
- Issues a GST tax invoice for every payment.

## Platforms

- Web: https://card2leads.brillbrainsconsultants.com/
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brillbrainsconsultants.card2leads
- Android package name: com.brillbrainsconsultants.card2leads

## Pricing

All plans are paid once, in Indian rupees, and do not auto-renew. One credit is
one card sent to be read; the front and back of the same card count as one.

- 699 INR - Starter Pack, 150 card scans, valid 30 days
- 1,299 INR - Exhibition Pass, 300 card scans, valid 90 days
- 5,799 INR - Pro Annual, 1,500 card scans, valid 12 months
- 799 INR - 200 extra scans, a one-time top-up that requires an active paid plan

Larger volumes are quoted per workspace. Prices include GST, and a tax invoice is
available for every payment.

## Data handling

- Card photographs and voice recordings are deleted 90 days after the card is created.
- Extracted contact details and voice note transcripts are kept for as long as the user keeps the record.
- Connecting a Google account is optional and is requested only when a feature needs it.
- Google data is never sold or used for advertising.
- Account deletion is requested in the app or at the deletion request page, and is carried out by the operator.
